verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator is documented only as an interactive mobile app, operated by tapping, swiping and scanning QR codes, with no documented headless mode, CLI or CI integration. The GitHub HOTP/TOTP implementations and the PAM module are developer building blocks and server-side verification components, not a way to run the product itself headlessly, so they earn no credit. Authenticator apps could plausibly ship CLI or automation access, so the axis applies and the absence of evidence means none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
